provenance: AI-authored after contract and prior-report review, separately from prior corpora. Same assistant authors and executes. No external annotator, representative sampling or blinding. No L7 parser execution before freeze.

scoring.fullCase: Exact ID/state set, required source substrings, intended clarify/abstain/confirm/conflict flags, valid proposal and literal provenance. Each case stays in denominator.
scoring.clarification: Initial-turn projected interaction: no observations, ambiguous unmapped clause, contradiction, or existing pain-location prompt. Actual helpful wording sampled separately in browser.
scoring.context: Temporal/speaker correctness reported as evidence-set correctness on the corresponding case subsets, not independent annotation accuracy.
scoring.provenance: Every emitted quote must occur literally in input; annotation offsets must reproduce quote. Literal correctness does not establish semantic correctness.
scoring.span: Expected spans are minimum semantic substrings; a wider original-text quote may match. Multi-span arrays require every listed substring.
scoring.abstain: Zero structured proposals, including UNKNOWN. Unsupported correctly retained/clarified is not successful supported extraction.
